name: Introduction to Analysis
description:
Metric space: Limits in metric spaces, Open sets, Closed sets, Relative metric, Completeness, Compact sets, Connected sets,
Separability
Continuity: Continuous functions on metric spaces, Homeomorphisms, Continuity and compactness, Continuity and connectedness, Uniform continuity
Sequences and series of functions: Pointwise and uniform convergence, The Weierstrass M-test, Uniform convergence and continuity, Uniform convergence and integration, Uniform convergence and differentiation, The Weierstrass theorem, equicontinuity and Ascoli-Arzela theorem.
Lebesgue measure: Outer measure, Lebesgue measure, Measurable sets, A Nonmeasurable set, Measurable functions
Lebesgue Integration: Simple functions, Integration of non-negative measurable functions, Monotone convergence theorem, Fatou’s lemma, Integration of absolutely integrable functions, Lebesgue dominated convergence theorem, Comparison with the Riemann integral
